parsed.note_claim: Cancer is caused by genetic mutations leading to uncontrolled growth of the body's own cells, not parasites.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Cancer is a genetic disease—that is, it is caused by changes to genes that control the way our cells function, especially how they grow and divide.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly defines cancer as a genetic disease caused by changes to genes that control cell growth and division.
